summary: Matthew Bachman, 49, of Oklahoma, killed snowmobiling in the Splains Gulch area toward Kebler Pass west of Crested Butte; a second rider was injured and transported to hospital; reported via Garmin inReach; Crested Butte SAR and Mt. Crested Butte police responded.
location: Splains Gulch area toward Kebler Pass, west of Crested Butte
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Mt. Crested Butte Police Department
notes: Crested Butte News, published 2024-02-28 (Gunnison County Sheriff's Office release). Victims = 1 killed + 1 injured. Run 1017 chunk C.
